title: VendPoint Usage Allowance Added to the Commercial Credit Account Step Room
content:
Usage billed on the customer's VendPoint Industrial Vending Program machines adds an allowance to **the step room** on a permanent increase of a Commercial Credit Account.

A VendPoint allowance is added to the step room from the usage billed across all the customer's VendPoint machines less than one whole month before today: the whole of that usage when it is at least three thousand dollars, one half of it when it is at least five hundred dollars but less than three thousand, and one quarter of it when it is less than five hundred dollars.

Whole months are the difference in calendar months between the usage bill's date and today, less one when today's day of the month is earlier than that date's day of the month.

| Usage billed less than one whole month before today, USD | Allowance |
|---|---|
| 3000.00 or more | the whole (100 percent) of that usage |
| 500.00 up to 2999.99 | one half (50 percent) |
| below 500.00 | one quarter (25 percent) |

*Hypothetical:* usage of 3000.00 gives 3000.00; 2999.99 gives 1499.995; 400.00 gives 100.00; no usage gives nothing.
